messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Observability vendor bakeoff & Q3 contract windows

Team —

We need a rapid recommendation on how to approach our Q3 contract windows for observability (Datadog, Grafana Cloud, Sentry). Attached I dropped the three vendor quotes that came in last week plus a draft comparison sheet. High-level asks:

- Can we treat this as a targeted bake-off (cost + retention strategy) rather than a full RFP?
- Identify 2 levers for immediate cost relief (e.g., retention tiering, compression/archive, committed throughput) that we can ask vendors for credits on.
- Define a short pilot we can run with Grafana/Grafana Metrics or S3-archive path for 90 days to prove cheaper cold retention.

Notes on constraints: our compliance team requires 365 days of searchable logs for security audits, but compliance is open to searchable-with-delay (index after 24-72h) if we compensate with better compression or smaller hot window. That’s why I want to prioritize retention tiers and test cold-store query performance.

Next steps: can each of you send back your top 3 negotiation asks + one technical unknown by EOD Friday? I’ll consolidate and schedule a 30m negotiation prep call with vendor reps next week.

Attachments: datadog_quote_Q3_2026.pdf; grafana_pricing_sheet_aug2026.pdf; vendor_comparison_sheet.xlsx

Thanks —
Mina

Thanks Mina — quick thoughts:

1) Top negotiation asks I recommend we take to all vendors:
   - 35-50% credit on ingestion for the first 3 months to offset migration/testing noise
   - Reduced egress/ingest pricing for archived queries (or include N free archive queries per month)
   - A firm SLA credit for indexing lag > 48h (so we can enforce searchable-with-delay guarantees)

2) One technical unknown: how each vendor measures "ingestion" vs "indexed tokens" for logs (Datadog historically bills on raw bytes ingested; Grafana Cloud is mixed). We need a canonical sample (3 days worth of logs) submitted to each vendor to get apples-to-apples pricing.

I can prepare the sample data and a small ingestion script this week.

On Tue, Aug 3, 2026 at 10:22 AM Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Mina — quick thoughts:
> 
> 1) Top negotiation asks I recommend we take to all vendors:
>    - 35-50% credit on ingestion for the first 3 months to offset migration/testing noise
>    - Reduced egress/ingest pricing for archived queries (or include N free archive queries per month)
>    - A firm SLA credit for indexing lag > 48h (so we can enforce searchable-with-delay guarantees)
> 
> 2) One technical unknown: how each vendor measures "ingestion" vs "indexed tokens" for logs (Datadog historically bills on raw bytes ingested; Grafana Cloud is mixed). We need a canonical sample (3 days worth of logs) submitted to each vendor to get apples-to-apples pricing.

Couple technical items from my side:

- Our steady-state ingest is ~3.8 TB/day compressed gzip, but actual uncompressed is ~11 TB/day. The retention profile is skewed: 90% of queries hit the last 7 days; 10% hit 7-90 days; <0.5% hit 90-365 days. That distribution matters — we can push significant savings by guaranteeing a small hot window and aggressive cold compression.

- For the pilot I propose: route a subset (5-10% of production volume) to Grafana Cloud with compressed chunking + S3 cold tier enabled. Measure query latency for 30/60/365d windows and the cost delta. If Grafana can give a small ingest credit to offset migration, it'll make the pilot cost-neutral.

- Unknown: Datadog's retention indexing API for partial reindexing — if they won't reindex cold data on demand cheaply, then searchable-with-delay won't be practical. Please flag that in asks.

I'll put a one-pager on technical acceptance criteria in the drive folder by tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Staff Software Engineer, Observability

Team / vendors —

Thanks for the rapid responses. Summary and agreed next steps:

1) Internal alignment: we will run a 6-week pilot (target start: Aug 17) as follows:
   - Grafana Cloud: 10% volume with S3 cold-path enabled (measure 30/60/365d query latency)
   - Datadog: parallel 10% volume with archive connector enabled (measure indexing lag and archive query cost)
   - Sentry: evaluate error/transaction retention change (focus scope on transaction traces > 7d)

2) Negotiation asks for vendor call:
   - 30-40% ingestion credit for 90 days to offset pilot migration load
   - Include N free archive queries/month (Datadog suggested 2,000) or equivalent egress credit
   - Commit language: pre-emptive 12-month commitment with opt-out window if pilot fails
   - SLA for indexing lag > 48h with credit or remediation plan

3) Logistics: Neha will prepare canonical 3-day sample logs and the ingestion script by Aug 10. Marcus will publish acceptance criteria and the measurement dashboard. Lauren will own negotiation coordination and DocuSign paperwork.

4) Prep call: schedule 30m with vendor reps (Carlos and Elena) and our team on Aug 12 at 10:00 PT. I’ll send the calendar invite and attach the consolidated asks doc.

Please reply only if you have objections to the pilot plan or the timeline. Otherwise I’ll lock the invite and post the tracker in the drive.

Mina
